errors.text: The proposed CaH2 getter conflicts with the target titanium-sponge oxygen getter and introduces unaddressed risks of calcium contamination and residual hydrogen.
The proposed argon treatment at 1200 °C for 2 hours substantially disagrees with vacuum sintering below 3×10⁻⁶ torr at 1400 °C for 18 hours, followed by water quenching from 1500 °C.
The predicted oxygen content below 500 ppm contradicts the target controlled oxygen level of approximately 1.0 wt.%, which contributes interstitial strengthening and phase behavior.
The predicted sub-micron grain size is incompatible with the observed post-quench grain size of 33 ± 19 µm.

The cited evidence concerns compositionally different refractory alloys and does not support CaH2 gettering, the proposed sintering schedule, oxygen threshold, grain refinement, or mechanical-property predictions.
